_meta.title: Decision package: low-traffic high-baseline working senior-care LP
_meta.why_strong_example: Demonstrates aggressive defer discipline + program-level strategic thinking. 4 plans considered → 1 ship + 2 iterate + 1 kill. Strategic recommendation points operator toward audience-level investment, not page tests.

prior_tests_tried: Hero subheadline tweak, no significant lift in April 2026
input_summary.page_works_summary: baseline=works; trust anatomy 55% load; preservation_zones include hero, phone, form_count, BBB stack

shipped_plans.why_this_first: Highest-confidence basic test; tests stacking density of trust badges (preservation-safe — adds, doesn't remove). Operator's traffic supports clean detection of 4-6% lift in window.

iterate_plans.blocker: Sample size insufficient — needs 12,000/arm to detect claimed 3% lift; operator only has 4,500/arm in window.
what_to_fix: Raise minimum_detectable_lift to 6%+ (more aggressive variant copy)
Or shrink test scope to one CTA on one viewport for cleaner signal

iterate_plans.blocker: Variant description ambiguous — 'rotate testimonials' doesn't specify which testimonials, in what order, or whether the rotation is per-page-load or session-persistent.
what_to_fix: Specify exactly 3-5 testimonial slots and which testimonials go in which
Specify rotation logic explicitly (per-page-load vs session-sticky)
Define how 'winner' would be measured given rotation (CTR per testimonial slot vs overall conversion)

killed_plans.kill_reason: Operator's prior_tests_tried already shows '4→3 form-field reduction, +6.2% lift in March 2026' — this plan is a near-duplicate hypothesis (just one more field reduction). Going from 3→2 may degrade lead quality (current 3-field form is filtering effectively). No new signal expected.

decision.strategic_recommendation: This page is mature: trust anatomy is 55% load, prior optimizations harvested obvious wins, traffic is constrained. Expect 3-7% lift max from page tests this cycle. Recommend allocating next quarter's optimization investment toward AUDIENCE expansion — current lookalike seeds are narrow, and the biggest growth lever is reaching adjacent senior-care segments (hearing aids, mobility aids) with the same trust-anatomy template.
constraint_warnings: operator's MDE floor at 4500/arm = ~5% relative lift on 21% baseline. Plans claiming smaller detectable effects are noise.
12k/month traffic limits to 1 sequential test per 2 weeks — parallel testing not supported here.
expert_conflicts_resolved: Hypothesis Generator's T1 plan claimed 3% expected lift on 4500/arm — feasibility check failed; downgraded to 'iterate' rather than 'ship'.
decision.next_batch_focus: Test trust-anatomy DENSITY (does adding a 4th badge improve conversion?) given current preservation discipline. Also: the operator should consider running an audience expansion test in parallel with the LP queue — different infrastructure but compounds with page learnings.
